Ollama provider sends the chat to /api/chat and maps the native reply, including token counts and finish reason

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
api_key = ENV.fetch("API_KEY")
client = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = client.chat_async(LiterLlm::ChatCompletionRequest.new(extra_body: { 'num_ctx' => 512, 'repeat_penalty' => 1.1, 'top_k' => 5 }, messages: [{ 'content' => 'Hello', 'role' => 'user' }], model: 'ollama/qwen2:0.5b'))
puts result.choices.inspect
puts result.choices[0].message.content.inspect
puts result.choices[0].finish_reason.inspect
puts result.model.inspect
puts result.usage.prompt_tokens.inspect
puts result.usage.completion_tokens.inspect
puts result.usage.total_tokens.inspect
```
